title: Custom web applications
text: .NET / ASP.NET backends with React or Angular front-ends and SQL Server. Back-office systems, portals, internal tools.

title: Integrations and APIs
text: REST APIs, partner and B2B system integrations, electronic document exchange, data imports and transformations.

title: Azure and DevOps

title: Mobile apps

title: Small-business web apps
